newsitem.title: MEXICO: FORECAST - Mexico 28-day Cetes seen at 24.06 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Mexico 28-day Cetes seen at 24.06 pct.

text.p: Interest rates on Mexico's bellwether 28-day Cetes, or T-bills, are seen falling 141 basis points to 24.06 percent at this week's auction, according to a Reuters' survey of 10 dealers.
Rates are also expected to fall on longer-term Cetes.
Following is a table comparing primary rates last week with expectations for this week's auction and the expected change in basis points.
